selection: Compare both matched seeds on grouped development. When both pass, lock the eligible field checkpoint with highest mean joint field macro-F1.
protocol: The reference and frozen candidate predict all 177 labels on the same source-specific confirmation images. Report crop error and joint results. Average joint macro-F1 over represented labels within each source then weight the two sources equally.
deployment_scope: This check covers two labels per crop. A pass is field corroboration for the two sampled collections. It does not justify claiming improvement over all 177 field conditions.
